parameters.name: AlertConfig
parameters.description:
The alert rule configurations.

Valid values of N: 1 to 3.

parameters.name: GroupId
parameters.description:
The ID of the application group.

For more information about how to obtain the ID of an application group, see [DescribeMonitorGroups](~~115032~~).

parameters.name: MatchExpress
parameters.description:
The expressions used to match instances.

Valid values of N: 1 to 3.

parameters.name: MatchExpressFilterRelation
parameters.description:
The logical operator used between conditional expressions that are used to match instances. Valid values:

*   all
*   and
*   or

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cms create-group-monitoring-agent-process --group-id 36070000 --process-name Process_Java --match-express-filter-relation and --match-express Function=startWith Value=portalHost Name=name1 --alert-config '[{"TargetList":[{"JsonParams":"customField1_:_value1_,_customField2_:_.name","Level":"INFO_,_WARN_,_CRITICAL","Id":"1","Arn":"acs:mns:cn-hangzhou:1208863178610000:/queues/test/message"}],"SilenceTime":"86400","NoEffectiveInterval":"00:00-05:30","ComparisonOperator":"GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold","Times":"3","Webhook":"https://www.aliyun.com","EscalationsLevel":"warn","EffectiveInterval":"07:00-22:59","Statistics":"Average","Threshold":"5"}]' --api-version 2019-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
